question: Can an uncached full-fleet has:plan query complete correctly, and what do unchanged and one-source-change queries cost?
measurement_kind: Clean release production core query::facts::filter_refs over explicit frozen SessionRefs; discovery and CLI row formatting excluded.
setup: APFS file clones, original harness stores read-only; SQLite main+present WAL/journal copied with stable before/after identities; copied SHM omitted. Frozen primary roots include nested data; companion stores outside copied roots may be absent. All phases use scratch catalogs and read scopes under a read-only-source sandbox.
probe_process_overhead: Process time includes loading refs, catalog::sync setup and result serialization. Filter timer excludes setup; process warm total is not warm CLI latency.

parallel.pressure_note: Primary-source bytes are conservative pressure, not an allocated-memory estimate; SQLite repeats the whole DB size per session.

serial_before_failed.error: backing range out of bounds; first needed Cursor empty encoded richText

validation.append_effect: Only changed Claude ref added; plan count absent->1,330->331 matches. No other selected ref removed.

interpretation: Current complete operation succeeds; prior revision fails before returning a query result. This is not an isolated parallelism comparison.
CPU and RSS rise with the combined revision and additional tail work; physical footprint remains modest. Mapped RSS is distinct from footprint.
Darwin reported zero block I/O counters; page faults are available, but these counters do not prove zero storage I/O.
Full selection must finish before first result; no partial output is emitted after a fallible read.
The historical60s CountsOnly index budget is a different workload; full index and parallel CountsOnly remain unmeasured here.

At the historical full-filter revisions above, limited machine requests still filtered the fleet before sorting and truncation. The later limited_window_work and demand_counts_work controls below document removal of that unnecessary fact reduction and whole-count-table loading.

limited_window_work.method: Deterministic native three-candidate has:plan correctness fixture, fresh scratch catalog; no timing campaign. Candidate 0 does not match, candidate 1 matches, candidate 2 is a matching tail.
limited_window_work.proxy_limit: Fresh count rows prove successful counted reads were published, not every read or byte consumed. Unchanged rows alone do not prove zero body demands; cached cheap decisions are covered by the existing predicate engine and unneeded-error controls.
limited_window_work.policy: JSON ranks before predicate evaluation and stops once its window is complete. Required candidate errors remain errors; unread lower-ranked errors cannot invalidate the window. Text listings and aggregate stats retain full selection and exact totals.
limited_window_work.global_work: At 6296f7db, nonzero counted windows loaded one whole-catalog AffordanceTable and dependency table. The follow-up demand reader below replaces this limited-query load; full sweeps retain their batch tables.
limited_window_work.ordering: Stable metadata ties and historical ascending select-then-reverse/existence rules are retained; CLI exact JSON row parity covers all three sorts and both directions.
limited_window_work.warm_decision_control: After initial publication, the shared planner returns definite False/True for the two required candidates, and Unknown for the uncounted tail; only Unknown invokes the body reducer. Parse-dependent predicates such as tool:edit still reduce required candidate bodies on repeat; affordance counts do not cache arbitrary predicates.

metadata_precision_note: Historical full-filter phases used second-precision frozen metadata; has:plan membership and counted-fact parity are unaffected. Ranked-window fixtures retain nanosecond metadata and stable ties.

demand_counts_work.method: Scoped deterministic tests only, no timing campaign. Existing explicitly owned catalog Reader; one prepared keyed join fetches counts and source provenance together.
demand_counts_work.boolean_shortcircuit_work: Metadata false AND counted, metadata true OR counted, and indexed text true OR counted settle through the existing three-valued evaluator without opening a counts Reader.
demand_counts_work.snapshot_policy: Count and provenance share a single statement snapshot per candidate; separate candidates may observe different committed records. No read transaction spans transcript reductions or catalog publication. SQL/cache errors remain misses; body read errors remain fallible.
demand_counts_work.freshness_oracle: Demand reader agrees with batch reader for fresh/missing/old-view/malformed counts, mismatched primary or provenance tuples, old/malformed/missing provenance, incomplete read sets, WAL appearance, conditional-sidecar appearance and changed primary. Retained Reader observes later publications and does not observe partial uncommitted writes.
demand_counts_work.limits: Counters measure demanded SQL lookups and successfully decoded joined rows, not page I/O, elapsed time or total listing work. Catalog initialization, discovered metadata inventory, stable ranking and text membership remain separate work; full sweeps keep batch counts loading.
